title: The empty crew envelope
beat: The emptied envelope settles flat on the ledger as Phil's right glove takes the folded cash toward his coat.
qa: The label and cash occupy separate areas of the frame. The receipt can be read at full size.

title: Rita heads for the doors
beat: Phil catches himself mid-sentence and lowers his hand as Rita turns toward the doors with her call sheet.
qa: Rita’s turn reads in profile. Snow has tracked farther into the lobby than in the master.

title: The cotton barely registers
beat: Fully dressed on the bed, Phil lets his hand rest on the sheet. From the far corner, he looks small against the quilt.
qa: Use during the afternoon hold. The line about the sheets continues into the existing dusk shot, when Phil sits up to tie his shoe.

title: Rita seats Alma’s cassette
beat: After receiving the cassette, Rita cues it at the Rialto deck while Larry checks the handwritten cue sheet.
qa: Larry watches the cue sheet while Rita works the deck. Cool window light is stronger than in the scripted evening.

title: Crew fares, first take
beat: Phil lifts the folded bills away from the ledger.
qa: An extra glove appears near the props. Use the corrected envelope still for the cut.
